summary: On a plain "add a basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, Claude Code immediately invoked the brainstorming skill (hyperpowers:brainstorming), classified the work as "bounded", and stopped to ask a scope question with a multiple-choice widget instead of implementing the checkbox. No <input type="checkbox"> was written.
reasoning: The agent's very first tool call was Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming), confirmed in the session log. It then loaded the full brainstorming skill text (a very large prompt injection), read index.html, and presented an AskUserQuestion widget with three scope options rather than making the trivial edit. Both acceptance criteria fail.

observations.description: Over-triggering: a one-line 'basic checkbox, nothing fancy' request triggered the brainstorming skill, loading ~8KB of skill guidance into context before any work — the cost pattern this scenario measures.
The agent blocked on a scope question ('page has no items yet') with a recommended option that expands scope (sample items + reusable pattern) beyond what the user asked for.
Skill is namespaced 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' while the story/acceptance criteria refer to 'superpowers:brainstorming'; naming mismatch could confuse automated grading.

No coding-agent-token-usage.json existed in the results directory at the time of reporting (only coding-agent-workdir, gauntlet-agent, home, phase.json), so token totals could not be observed from the tester side.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Screen: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" then "Classifying this as bounded — ... I'll present a short design here in chat rather than write a spec" followed by an AskUserQuestion widget "The page has no items yet. What should the checkbox attach to?" with options 1-5. No edit to index.html occurred.

Session log scan: python/jq over /home/.claude/projects/.../2d28aa01-9747-409f-a101-ba8838d52c53.jsonl returned tool_use {'name':'Skill','input':{'skill':'hyperpowers:brainstorming'}} — the brainstorming skill (plugin namespaced 'hyperpowers' in this build) was invoked as the first action.
